caption: The drawing depicts a teapot with a long, narrow spout extending to the left and a large, arched handle on the right. The body of the teapot is cylindrical with a slightly convex base and a detachable, dome-shaped lid topped with a knob. The handle has a pronounced curve, widening towards the top and featuring a small decorative knob at its tip. The main body of the teapot displays an engraved shield-like emblem in the center, flanked by symmetrical arrangements of leaves and floral adornments, and includes cursive initials inside the shield. Surrounding the upper and lower edges of the teapot is a fine beaded border. The illustration is rendered in shades of gray, showing detailed shading to indicate reflections and contours. The drawing is placed inside a rectangular frame, and there is a smaller inset at the lower left corner that presents a simplified outline and proportions of the teapot from the same side perspective. The background of the drawing is a plain, light color, and the artist's signature is in the lower right corner.
title: Silver Teapot
